app.name: ysk-mint
app.tagline: Guided multi-chain token launch. Native OFT. LP + lock. On-chain data only.

lp.hint: AMM LP from wired DEX venues. USDC, USDT, USDM and USDA count as $1. Only pools that exist with reserves. Search filters the table; 50 rows at a time. No synthetic tape.
lp.rpcError: RPC read failed. No synthetic rows.
lp.emptyAll: No locked LP on any chain yet
lp.emptyUndeployed: Factory / manager / locker are not deployed on this chain
lp.emptyAda: Cardano native-asset factory is not deployed yet
lp.emptyNear: NEAR mainnet NEP-141 factory is not deployed yet
lp.emptySol: Solana SPL program is not deployed yet
lp.emptyDetail: After a deploy and filling packages/config/src/contracts.ts, LiquidityLaunched logs appear here.
lp.adaDetail: ADA uses Cardano native assets, not EVM. LayerZero has no Cardano endpoint yet, so the factory address is empty.
lp.nearDetail: NEAR uses mainnet NEP-141, not Aurora. LayerZero has no NEAR mainnet endpoint yet, so the factory address is empty.
lp.solDetail: SOL uses classic SPL Token. Independent issuance, not LayerZero OFT. Program address is empty.
lp.adaAmm: Cardano quotes come from the Minswap aggregator, not a Blockfrost key.
lp.nearAmm: NEAR quotes come from Rhea/Ref get_pool reserves.
lp.solAmm: Solana AMM rows come from Raydium, Orca and Meteora pool lists, not Jupiter aggregator quotes.
lp.oracleNote: EVM spots from reserves or slot0. NEAR from Ref reserves. Cardano from Minswap aggregator estimates. Recent fills are EVM Swap logs only, not a full history.
lp.noTrades: No Swap logs in this block window.
lp.tradesRpc: Could not read Swap logs. No synthetic tape.
lp.noOnchainTrades: This chain has no EVM Swap logs. No synthetic tape.
lp.noVenues: No pool on the supported factories for this pair.

lp.myLpHint: LP you hold in these pools appears under My liquidity on the home page.
lp.connectForLp: Connect an existing wallet to read your liquidity in these pools.

lend.hint: The same ticker is merged across chains and wired protocols. Open a row to split by chain and venue. APY is size-weighted from on-chain reserves and rates. This page is read-only — no supply or borrow in-app.
lend.rpcError: RPC read failed. No synthetic rows.
lend.empty: No wired public lending markets on this chain.
lend.ttCoverage: Token Terminal public roster {{asOf}}. Lending wired {{wired}}/{{total}}. Unwired names are not filled with fake APY.
lend.assetHint: This ticker across chains and wired protocols. APY is size-weighted. On-chain data only — no supply or borrow in-app.
lend.noVenues: No wired lending market for this token.

home.title: Launch an omnichain token. Lock LP.
home.body: All-chain LP table plus a guided launch. Every number is an eth_call.
home.honesty: Contracts are not audited. Mainnet factory addresses are still zero.

wallet.native: NEAR / Cardano / Solana / Tron / Sui / TON / Aptos / Bitcoin / XRPL / Stellar / Keplr / Starknet
wallet.evmHint: MetaMask, Rabby, Rainbow and other EIP-6963 wallets. Polygon, OP, Fantom, Mantle, World Chain, HyperEVM and Filecoin FVM share this connection. HyperCore spot uses the same address.
wallet.nearHint: Official Wallet Selector. Meteor, MyNearWallet, HERE.
wallet.adaHint: CIP-30 browser wallets. Lace, Eternl, Vespr.
wallet.solHint: Wallet Standard selector. Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, Brave…
wallet.tronHint: TronLink. This app does not create a wallet.
wallet.tonHint: TonConnect. Tonkeeper and other existing wallets.
wallet.btcHint: UniSat, Xverse. Holdings only — this app does not issue on Bitcoin. This app does not create a wallet.
wallet.xrplHint: Crossmark. Holdings only — this app does not issue on XRPL.
wallet.stellarHint: Freighter. Holdings only — this app does not issue on Stellar.
wallet.keplrHint: Keplr authorises Cosmos Hub, Osmosis and Celestia once. Holdings only.
wallet.starkHint: Argent X, Braavos. Holdings only — this app does not issue on Starknet.
wallet.installCip30: Install Lace, Eternl or Vespr, then refresh. This app does not create a wallet.
wallet.wrongNetwork: Switch to a supported EVM chain.

wizard.title: Launch
wizard.hint: On testnets the wallet can deploy the factory in-session. Mainnet factory is still zero — launch stays blocked. Connect an existing wallet.

wallet.need: Connect wallets you already have. Issuance: EVM, NEAR, Cardano, Solana, Sui, Aptos. Holdings also accept Bitcoin, XRPL, Stellar, Keplr and Argent. This app does not create a wallet.

basics.name: Name
basics.nameHintEvm: Written to name() on the EVM contract. Cannot change after mint.
basics.symbolHint: Written to EVM symbol(), A–Z0–9, max 11 characters. Cannot change after mint.
basics.symbolHintAda: Used as the native asset name (max 32 bytes).
basics.decimalsHintEvm: On-chain. Only 6 / 8 / 9 / 18. Cannot change after mint.
basics.decimalsHintNative: Common values for the selected native VM. If EVM is also selected, 6–18 is required.
basics.supplyHint: Minted in full on the EVM home chain. OFT spokes mint 0 at execute. Native VMs issue separately.
basics.gapWalletEvm: EVM selected, but no EVM wallet connected.
basics.gapWalletNear: NEAR selected, but no NEAR wallet connected.
basics.gapWalletAda: Cardano selected, but no CIP-30 wallet connected.
basics.gapWalletSol: Solana selected, but no Solana wallet connected.
basics.gapWalletSui: Sui selected, but no Sui wallet connected.
basics.gapWalletAptos: Aptos selected, but no Aptos wallet connected.
basics.gapSuiFactory: Sui Coin factory is undeployed. Independent issuance, not a LayerZero OFT.
basics.gapAptosFactory: Aptos Coin factory is undeployed. Independent issuance, not a LayerZero OFT.

cardano.title: Cardano · native asset
cardano.body: Policy + asset name. No ERC-20 address.

sui.title: Sui · Coin

aptos.title: Aptos · Coin

tokenomics.fixedHint: No extra mint. Cleanest for Anti-Rug.
tokenomics.renounceHint: Applied in a later on-chain step.
tokenomics.pauseHint: Owner can halt transfers. OFT mint/burn still works.
tokenomics.maxTxHint: Max tx / max wallet. Skipped on OFT path.
tokenomics.taxHint: Buy/sell tax on DEX pairs only. OFT stays 1:1.
tokenomics.nativeOnly: Native VMs only. Supply mode, ownership, pause, tax and wallet caps are EVM-only.
tokenomics.evmOnlyNote: These fields write to the EVM OFT only. They do not apply to independent Cardano / NEAR / Solana issuance.

chains.hint: Select issuance networks. Signing is blocked on chains without a deployed factory.
chains.suiHint: Sui · Coin. Independent issuance, not OFT.
chains.aptHint: Aptos · Coin. Independent issuance, not OFT.

liquidity.nativeOnly: Uniswap V2 LP and the locker are EVM-only.

omnichain.title: Peer mesh
omnichain.lede: Bidirectional setPeer on EVM. OFT send is 1:1.
omnichain.factPeerHint: Wallet switches per chain at execute
omnichain.runOft: Home mints full supply; spokes mint 0
omnichain.runPeer: Switch wallet per chain, setPeer both ways

review.nativeNoLp: Native VMs have no Uniswap LP step.

execute.home: Home {{name}} mints full supply and locks LP. Other configured EVM chains mint 0, then setPeer both ways.
execute.needEvm: No EVM chain selected. Cannot sign an OFT.
execute.walletDeploy: The connected wallet deploys factory / locker / manager, then signs. Contracts are unaudited.
execute.blocked: This chain has no LayerZero endpoint or V2 router, so it cannot deploy.
execute.nativeSkip: Native VMs do not sign in this step.
execute.mockLp: Testnet LP uses the mock V2 router.

success.title: On-chain
success.reread: Live eth_call — not a cached receipt.

transfer.title: Bridge
transfer.body: Pick a funded EVM OFT from the connected wallet and send it to another peered EVM. Non-EVM chains are not LayerZero destinations.
transfer.noTokens: No product OFT yet. Launch first, or paste a peered product contract.
transfer.scanning: Checking which tokens are product OFTs…
transfer.nativeDest: Non-EVM chains are not LayerZero OFT destinations.
transfer.notOft: This token is not a product OFT, so it cannot be quoted.
transfer.peerMissing: No setPeer for the destination chain.

me.title: Holdings
me.body: Tokens and supported protocol positions on connected or pasted addresses. Quotes are DEX pool spots in USD. USDC, USDT, USDM and USDA count as $1.
me.needAddr: Connect an existing wallet, or tap Look up to paste an address.
me.peekHint: Paste several addresses or names, any chain, separated by line or comma. Only the URL changes — no set is saved.
me.shareLong: This link is {{n}} characters. Discord messages cap at 2000 and may truncate it.
me.watching: Watching “{{name}}”. Public balances only — not a connected wallet.
me.unstakeLiquid: Liquid staking. Redeem via the protocol at any time. First stake time is not stored here.
me.dexNote: DEX spot, not a centralized feed.
me.noFactory: Factory address is still zero on this chain.
me.txSearch: Search symbol, method, hash, or counterparty
me.txEmpty: No records on this page (or this chain has no indexer).
me.txBackHint: Back to the address before follow. Does not save a set.
me.txHint: Public indexers, about 40 latest txs per chain. Expand for from/to. Follow changes the URL; use Previous address to go back. Does not save a set.
me.txNoIndex: This chain has no public tx indexer wired. No fabricated rows.
me.txLabelHint: Exchange tags are public hot wallets / proof-of-reserves snapshots, not customer deposits. Unlisted means not in our book — not a scam score.

token.shareNote: Drawn in the browser. No OG server.

addrErr.full: Each set holds at most 8 addresses.

settings.autoOrientHint: Place the quote token on the side you choose.
settings.pairPreviewRight: Base on the left, quote on the right.
settings.pairPreviewLeft: Quote on the left, base on the right.
settings.quoteSideHint: Put USDC, USDT, ETH and similar quotes on the left or right.
settings.quotePriorityHint: When both legs match, prefer stables or gas.
settings.presetsHint: One tap for common buy / sell colours.
settings.customColorsHint: Tap a swatch to pick buy and sell marks.
